description.value: Southside Lodge is a small hostel-style accommodation operated by Whistler Snowboard Tours, situated in Whistler Creekside approximately 400m from the Creekside Gondola. Running since 1993 under the ownership of Maxwell, it positions itself as an affordable, no-frills base for accessing Whistler Blackcomb. Touring cyclists passing through Whistler would find it a conveniently located and budget-conscious overnight option near the Creekside village.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM-listed URL (https://www.snowboardwhistler.com/southside) returns a 404, but the site's home page confirms Southside Lodge exists: 'Located in the heart of Whistler Creekside, Southside Lodge is situated 400m from the Creekside Gondola.' The copyright year '© 2026' and active contact form indicate the business is currently operating. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, laundry, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all amenity fields default to null.
